about: Run by ScrubParityTest.kt and scrubParity.test.ts. expected is what the line carries under key (a reserved key as field_<key>). held.textOnly is masked in free text alone: the code (M3). Both runners protect held more than once, as production does, before each row.

cases.why: a never key is masked whatever it holds
a never key masks a number too
a code is never written, under its own key
an unknown key masks a string
a number passes under any key
a boolean passes under any key
a failure kind passes as a plain word, under the reserved name
null passes under any key
a plain word passes a plain key
a sentence under a plain key is masked whole
a secret under a plain key is masked whole
a stream id under a plain key is masked whole
a public playback URL passes, the stream id in its path allowed
a URL with a query is masked whole
a URL with a harmless query is masked whole too
a URL with a token in its path is masked whole
an http URL is masked whole
a URL with userinfo is masked whole
a non-breaking space is not ASCII whitespace, so it does not break a public URL on either side
a line separator is not ASCII whitespace either (Java's \v class holds it; JS's \v does not)
a vertical tab is ASCII whitespace, so a URL holding one is masked whole
text masks a raw secret in place
text masks a form-encoded secret in place
text masks a component-encoded secret in place
text masks the stream id in place
text whose lowercase escapes still reveal a secret is masked whole
text with no secret passes as written
a public URL carrying a secret encoded twice is masked whole
text carrying a secret encoded twice is masked whole
a secret beside non-ASCII text is masked, the rest kept
a plain word of 63 characters passes
a plain word of exactly 64 characters passes
a plain word of 65 characters is masked whole: the bound is what keeps an unheld long token off a plain key
a plain word may hold a colon, a dot, a dash and an underscore
a URL with a fragment in its path is masked whole
a URL with a fragment straight after its host is masked whole
a public URL with a port passes
a URL whose port is not a number is masked whole
the scheme passes in any ASCII case
a long s is not an s: no Unicode case folding on either side, so this scheme is masked whole
a field named level is written field_level, never as the line's level
text naming the code masks it in place: the code is masked in free text (M3)
text naming the code beside the token masks both in place
a plain word containing the code passes: the code is masked in free text alone
an escape spelled with an Arabic-Indic digit is a hex digit on both sides, so the key it reveals masks the text whole
an escape spelled with a fullwidth digit and a fullwidth letter decodes too, so the key it reveals masks the text whole
a digit outside the BMP is two UTF-16 units, neither a hex digit on either side, so the escape is none and the text passes as written
text carrying a secret encoded twice among other words is masked whole, after a second protect too

kinds.why: a kind that holds a secret is masked
a kind that is not a word is masked
a kind containing the code passes: the code is masked in free text alone
